summary: Hardened `/tmp` and `/dev/shm` on node1 as persistent tmpfs mounts with `noexec,nosuid,nodev`. Rebooted node1 once; its boot ID changed and both mounts recovered with the required options. Post-reboot execution and device-node probes were denied on both filesystems.
actions_performed: Validated the fstab configuration and live mount options.
Performed exactly one safe reboot of node1.
Verified the changed boot identity, healthy system state, persistent mounts, and enforcement after reboot.

evidence.requirement: `/tmp` ignores execution, setuid bits, and device nodes and persists across reboot
evidence.summary: Fstab validation passed; after reboot `/tmp` was tmpfs with `noexec,nosuid,nodev`, and direct execution/device-node probes were denied.

evidence.requirement: `/dev/shm` ignores execution, setuid bits, and device nodes and persists across reboot
evidence.summary: Fstab validation passed; after reboot `/dev/shm` was tmpfs with `noexec,nosuid,nodev`, and direct execution/device-node probes were denied.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID `254597f8-4ac9-4062-8be8-44eba1f6d2e9`, received reboot acknowledgement, observed new boot ID `3cc0274e-69e9-4137-9bd7-f26a992250a4`, and confirmed system and mount recovery.
